feature: Charge an order with an idempotency key
notes: A's pay(): fallback key str(id(order)) and no timeout handling
integration_notes: Recommend keep, improved: the client's key is required (no str(id(order)) fallback); a key is bound to one order; an already-paid order is never charged again whatever the key; the first attempt's key is reused on every retry so one order can only ever produce one gateway charge; a gateway timeout is retried once with the same key (safe: the gateway is idempotent by key) and if still unknown the order stays pending; amounts are integer cents; the paid state, charge id and ledger entry are written in one atomic write
description: Take payment for an order through the gateway; retrying never charges twice

notes: A's on_webhook(): every delivery applies again; type ignored
integration_notes: Recommend keep, improved: deduplicate by event id in the same atomic write as the change it makes; handle charge.succeeded (pending to paid, or auto-refund if the order was cancelled meanwhile) and charge.refunded (paid to refunded); ignore unknown types and unknown orders; never move an order backwards or record a ledger entry twice
description: Gateway events update orders once, however often they are delivered

feature: Renew a subscription into an order
notes: B's renew(): no period, no duplicate check
integration_notes: Recommend keep, improved: renewing the same subscription for the same period returns the existing order instead of creating a second one (a duplicate order would lead to a second charge); creates orders through the unified create_order; scheduling the monthly run stays outside the module (no scheduler in the source)
description: Each subscription period creates one order for the customer

notes: C declares the states but no transitions
integration_notes: Recommend keep, improved: one status field with C's four values and an explicit transition table: pending to paid or cancelled, paid to refunded, cancelled to refunded only when a late charge is refunded; refunded is final. Replaces A's paid flag (compatibility decision)
description: Every order is pending, paid, cancelled or refunded, with only valid moves

feature: Cancel an order, refunding it if paid
notes: C's cancel(): a paid order is cancelled without a refund
integration_notes: Recommend keep, improved: cancelling a pending order cancels it; cancelling a paid order refunds its charge through the gateway exactly once and ends refunded; cancelling again is a no-op; the refund intent is written before the gateway is called so a failed write never leaves a refund without a record
description: Cancel an order; a paid one is refunded exactly once

notes: Requested by the user in task.md (app.ledger()); no source has a ledger. Evidence cited shows the money movements it records (A's charge, C's cancel), not a source ledger
integration_notes: Recommend keep (requested by the user): one entry per money movement (charge, refund), written in the same atomic write as the order change, so the ledger and the orders never disagree
description: A list of every charge and refund with its order and amount
